caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of textile featuring a central vertical strip adorned with large, stylized floral designs in shades of red, orange, pink, and yellow, accented with green leaves. This central strip is flanked on both sides by bands of a lighter, lace-like pattern in a grayish tone, with a scalloped outer edge. The background of the image is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature, "Herbert Marsh," appears in the lower right corner. The floral pattern is detailed and vibrant, standing in contrast against the more muted and delicate lace design on the sides.
title: Dress Trimming
